description: OpenSpec spec steps: a behaviour change is a proposal, spec deltas, design and tasks before code; the spec is reviewed, the build is checked against its scenarios, and the spec is archived into openspec/specs/. The build and the fixes are the change cycle's own.

steps.does: review the spec; it takes the place of the design review
each group's brief is `kit packet <change> <group>`; groups in tasks.md order
one more judge: every scenario mapped to a test
a Gap whose cause is the spec goes to the author first

stages.name: apply
stages.note: Build it as step 2 of the change cycle: one `delegate:worker` per group, brief `kit packet <change> <group>`, groups in tasks.md order.

stages.name: verify
stages.note: Run step 4 of the change cycle; `openspec:spec-conformance` is among the judges.
